resource.title: STAT 415: Introduction to Mathematical Statistics — Penn State Department of Statistics (free online course notes, OER)
resource.covers: Penn State 统计学系做的公开课讲义网站（CC BY-NC 授权，自述为 open educational resources），目录为：0 复习 STAT 414；1 次序统计量；2–3 点估计（无偏、MSE、充分性、因子分解）；4–5 最大似然估计；6 置信区间；7–8 MLE 的渐近分布；9–10 假设检验（含 Wald 检验、p 值、功效）；11 贝叶斯方法；12 简单线性回归。对应节点的抽样分布、估计、检验、似然、置信区间与渐近理论；决策一条只到检验的势函数层面。

courses.course: MATH 181A Introduction to Mathematical Statistics I
courses.prereq_text: Prior or concurrent enrollment in MATH 109 is highly recommended. Prerequisites: MATH 180A, and MATH 18 or MATH 20F or MATH 31AH, and MATH 20C. Students who have not completed listed prerequisites may enroll with consent of instructor.

courses.course: STAT 341 Introduction to Probability and Mathematical Statistics II
courses.prereq_text: Brief review of: sample spaces, random variables, probability. Distribution: binomial, normal, Poisson, geometric. Followed by: expectation, variance, central limit theorem. Basic concepts of estimation, testing, and confidence intervals. Maximum likelihood estimators and likelihood ratio tests, efficiency. Introduction to regression. Course overlaps with: TSTAT 346. Prerequisite: STAT 340 or MATH 394/STAT 394; and STAT 311 or STAT 390.

extra_prereqs.evidence: UCSD MATH 181A 明确要求 'MATH 18 or MATH 20F or MATH 31AH'（三者都是线性代数）。
UCSD MATH 181A 明确要求 MATH 20C（多元微积分），用于多元分布与随机变量变换。
UCSD MATH 181A 原文：'Prior or concurrent enrollment in MATH 109 is highly recommended'（MATH 109 = Mathematical Reasoning，证明写作）。

notes: 资源站点用 tavily_extract 打开成功并读到完整目录与 About 段；本机 research_tool.py fetch 对该域名一直报 SSLCertVerificationError（'unable to get local issuer certificate'，环境证书问题，非站点失效），所以没能在本地缓存正文。两门课的先修原文都取自可正常抓取的公开课程目录（UCSD catalog、UW course catalog）。UW STAT 341 的先修里 STAT 340 就是节点 M.6.1 的内容；UCSD 那条把线性代数与多元微积分也列为必修，故另记入 extra_prereqs。
